_comment_graph: Base Graph API wiring. The effective billing root is composed as {GraphBaseUri}/{ApiVersion}/{BillingRootPath}. With the shipped defaults that resolves to https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/costManagement
_comment_billingRootPath: DOCUMENTED BEST GUESS. The internal API doc lists endpoint paths (/spendingPolicies, /getTenantCreditBalance(), /userBalances, ...) but not the root segment they hang off. If the startup connection probe reports HTTP 404, change BillingRootPath only - no code changes are required. Run Test-CoworkPolicyConnection -AutoDiscover to probe every entry in BillingRootPathCandidates and be told which one works.
_comment_auth: Delegated interactive sign-in via Connect-MgGraph. Adjust scopes if your tenant's consent prompt reports an unknown or insufficient permission. TenantId and ClientId are optional; leave empty to use the default Microsoft Graph PowerShell application.
_comment_limits: Hard minimums are enforced as validation errors. Recommended values are enforced as warnings only - rows still pass validation and can still be committed.
_comment_output: Report and log output. Relative paths are resolved against the tool root.
